entries.head: traceql
entries.rationale: Defensive: lowerRoot rejects an empty top-level pipeline and hands this helper one that keeps its first element (withImplicitSpansetFilter puts `{ }` before a leading by(), and dropGroupByBeforeMetrics drops only by() stages, so `by(name) | rate()` arrives as `{ }`), and a parsed sub-pipeline operand always carries at least one element, so the empty-pipeline branch is unreachable.
